quests.title: Wolves at the Door
quests.description: Bleak Worgs have been trotting up the Deathknell road after dark. They haven't bitten anyone in Brill yet, which Rennick considers a stroke of luck and a warning. Thin the pack in Nightmare Vale before the luck runs out.
quests.accept_text: Take the west road down to the Vale. Eight worgs. Bring me the count and I'll pretend I'm not worried.
quests.turn_in_text: Eight? Good. Brill sleeps lighter than it admits. Take something from the crate.

unique_item_defs.name: Dusk-Vale Coat
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Somebody left it where the road bends. You can see why.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Dusk-Vale Fists
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The Vale never lets you wash it out.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Gloves (Str/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Moth-Eaten Shield
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Smells of loam and wolf. Both are mostly gone.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Str/Spi)

quests.title: Into the Nightmare Vale
quests.description: Nobody has walked Nightmare Vale's lower road since the worgs came. Rennick wants someone to walk it end to end and report what is waiting at the bottom, because 'something' is a poor basis for a patrol roster.
quests.accept_text: South-west of the Cold Hearth road, past the Deathknell gate, the road goes into the trees. Walk it. Don't dawdle.
quests.turn_in_text: So it's quiet down there. I like quiet less than you'd think. Good work.

unique_item_defs.name: Dusk-Vale Legplates
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The Vale never lets you wash it out.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Legs (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Nightmare Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cut for someone who lived in the dark, and liked it.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Gloves (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Nightmare Talisman
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Smells of loam and wolf. Both are mostly gone.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/Sta)

quests.title: Thin the Glades
quests.description: The Wretched Zombies that wander the glades west of Brill have started drifting toward the gate. They are slow and stupid and mean no harm, but the gate guard has a quota of corpses he is willing to step over.
quests.accept_text: Out along the road west. Zombies. Put eight of them down and I'll let you back in without a lecture.
quests.turn_in_text: That's the road clear. I was getting a crick from all the stepping over.

unique_item_defs.name: Ashen Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A village thing: cheap, mended and cared for.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Gloves (Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Town-Crier's Cuisses
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Brill makes do. This is proof.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Legs (Str/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Gallows' End Flail
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A village thing: cheap, mended and cared for.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str)

quests.title: Tidings from the Landing
quests.description: Wexley prides himself on hearing everything first, and he has heard the Undercity zeppelin tower east of Brill is open for passengers. He has no way to confirm it. He would very much like you to go and look.
quests.accept_text: East along the high road, then south. The tower is a tangle of ropes and goblin curses. Go and tell me if it's real.
quests.turn_in_text: Real! Real, and open for custom. I shall cry it from the steps. Thank you.

unique_item_defs.name: Landing-Dock Belt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Goblin work: sturdy, overpriced and slightly wrong.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Belt (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Cargo-Hauler's Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Goblin work: sturdy, overpriced and slightly wrong.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Bracers (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Cargo-Hauler's Flail
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Whoever carried freight in this carried it well.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str)

quests.title: Word from the Ruins
quests.description: The Landing is one thing. The Ruins of Lordaeron, just south, are another: the old capital, gate to the Undercity, and full of rumours the town crier cannot afford to miss. Walk the approach and see who is still home.
quests.accept_text: South of the landing, along the road the Dark Lady took. Don't linger. The ghosts remember being important.
quests.turn_in_text: The old throne's cold, then. Pity. It was a lovely rumour.

unique_item_defs.name: Weathered-Banner Sash
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Once somebody's best.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Belt (Int/SP/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Ruin-Dust Spaulders
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Once somebody's best.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Shoulders (Sta/Def/Dodge)

unique_item_defs.name: Royal Guard's Pike
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Gold braid, faded to grey.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Sta/Armor/Parry)

quests.title: Blight Pumpkins
quests.description: Assistant Grael needs the pumpkins the Solliden thrashers are growing: swollen, grey-green things that ferment into the Apothecary's best base for plague reagents. He will not go near them himself. The thrashers hit back.
quests.accept_text: The Grain Threshers in the Solliden fields carry them. Five, uncracked, please. I'm very particular about cracks.
quests.turn_in_text: Perfectly foul. Look at the colour. Take something from the shelf, you've earned it.

unique_item_defs.name: Tithe-Barn Hauberk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A farmer wore this to work in rain that never ends.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Chest (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Harvest-Blighted Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Rough, practical, and faintly sour.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Gloves (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Harvest-Blighted Sword
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The harvest rots where it stands. So does this.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Str/Int)

quests.title: Pearls from the Bay
quests.description: The Vile Fin oracles on Whispering Shore wear salt-pearls the Apothecary can grind into a calming powder. Grael has no idea what the Vile Fins want them for, and not much interest in the answer.
quests.accept_text: North-west, where the bay meets the dead marsh. The little oracles. Five pearls, and don't scratch them.
quests.turn_in_text: Lovely lustre. Ground fine, these'll keep a grave-robber asleep for a month. Take your pick.

unique_item_defs.name: Kelp-Woven Skirt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Wind off the water gets in the seams.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Legs (Sta/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Tide-Worn Pauldrons
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Dried by wind, never by sun.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Shoulders (Str/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Shore-Reed Signet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Wind off the water gets in the seams.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Brightwater Ice
quests.description: Brightwater Lake sheds shards of black ice no matter the weather, and the weeping shades that stalk its shore carry them like keepsakes. The Apothecary uses them for cold-fixing. Grael needs five.
quests.accept_text: Eastern Tirisfal, Brightwater Lake. The shades and the drowned wretches carry fragments. Bring five, and gloves.
quests.turn_in_text: Cold enough to hurt. Excellent. Your reward is on the third shelf. Do not touch the fourth.

unique_item_defs.name: Brightwater Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Water beads and runs off, or doesn't.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Legs (Str/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Iceshard Girdle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Frost along the hem, even in summer.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Belt (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Lakeshore Ring
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Water beads and runs off, or doesn't.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Fresh Graves, Empty
quests.description: Gravedigger Hollis has been digging graves for thirty years, living and dead, and he knows when one's been robbed. Rot Hide gnolls up at Garren's Haunt are doing it, and they leave the bodies in the wrong places.
quests.accept_text: The graverobbers use shovels. I recognise the shovels. They're mine. Put them in the ground.
quests.turn_in_text: Six less. I'd say rest in peace, but they never earned it. Take your pick.

unique_item_defs.name: Haunt-Stitched Helm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Stitched together by something with very little patience.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Helm (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Garren's Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Stitched together by something with very little patience.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Boots (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Gnoll-Chewed Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Dog-chewed and worse.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Returned to the Earth
quests.description: Whatever the robbers and the crypt wights took, Hollis wants it back in the ground where it belongs: rings, seals, little carved relics from the Agamand family vault.
quests.accept_text: The wights in the Agamand crypt and the robbers at Garren's Haunt carry the best of it. Five relics, and no keeping any.
quests.turn_in_text: All present. I'll bury them tonight with a proper word. Take something from the barrow.

unique_item_defs.name: Wight-Bone Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The Agamand family kept their dead dressed. This is what they wore.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Boots (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Wight-Bone Skirt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The Agamand family kept their dead dressed. This is what they wore.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Legs (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Mausoleum Rod
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Damp stone and older dust.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand (Int/Spi)

quests.title: A Brother in the Crusade
quests.description: Meryl Ashdown has a brother in the Scarlet Crusade. She wants to know if he is still alive, still sane, or still listed. Convert orders from the Crusader Outpost might tell her. She will not ask what you do to get them.
quests.accept_text: The Crusader Outpost west of the Solliden farms. The recruits carry their orders on them. Please. Five. And don't hurt him if you meet him.
quests.turn_in_text: ...He's on the roster. Alive, at least. Thank you. I won't forget this. Take something. It was his.

unique_item_defs.name: Scarlet Picket's Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Crimson dye, fading in the rain.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Cloak (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Scarlet Picket's Pauldrons
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Whoever wore it believed every word of the sermon.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Shoulders (Str/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Scarlet Picket's Walking Stick
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Standard issue, and mostly standard.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int)

quests.title: Crows Over Brill
quests.description: Old Farmer Nettles swears the duskbats over the glades are the crows that used to eat his barley, and that they're still after it. Nothing grows, but he insists on the principle.
quests.accept_text: Out in the glades, the big grey ones. They've had my crop and my patience. Eight of them, if you please.
quests.turn_in_text: Eight. I'll hang them on the fence. It's what you do. Take some of the old tack.

unique_item_defs.name: Harvest-Blighted Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Rough, practical, and faintly sour.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Cloak (Int/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Tithe-Barn Chain Belt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The harvest rots where it stands. So does this.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Belt (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Solliden Hammer
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A farmer wore this to work in rain that never ends.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Straw and Sorrow
quests.description: Pruit tends the scarecrows that guard Brill's plots. The Rotting Dead that stumble in from the glades keep knocking them down and, worse, leaving their own shapes on the posts. He wants them cleared.
quests.accept_text: Seven, and don't bring them back. I'll make do with straw.
quests.turn_in_text: Straw's easier to stand up than they are. Thank you, friend. Take what you need.

unique_item_defs.name: Pumpkin-Vine Robe
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Rough, practical, and faintly sour.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Chest (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Furrow-Worn Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Rough, practical, and faintly sour.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Legs (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Furrow-Worn Band
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A farmer wore this to work in rain that never ends.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Str/Sta)

quests.title: A Toll for the Drowned
quests.description: The bell-ringer rings once a day for those lost at Brightwater Lake. Lately the Drowned Wretches ring back, from the water. He wants them quiet.
quests.accept_text: East past Brill, the big lake on the north side. They rise at dusk and wail. Seven, please.
quests.turn_in_text: Quieter, I think. Or I've gone deaf. Either way, thank you.

unique_item_defs.name: Lakeshore Breeches
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The lake keeps things cold. This is still cold.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Legs (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Cold-Water Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It was a fisher's before the lake started crying.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Bracers (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Shade-Haunted Blade
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It was a fisher's before the lake started crying.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Str)

quests.title: Silence the Weeping
quests.description: The Weeping Shades answer the toll with their own. It is the worst sound in Tirisfal. Ohmsted would like them gone, or at least discouraged.
quests.accept_text: Same lake. The shades. They're rather high-handed about it. Six, if you can stomach it.
quests.turn_in_text: I can hear the bell again. It's a lovely sound, if you're me.

unique_item_defs.name: Iceshard Sabatons
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Water beads and runs off, or doesn't.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Boots (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Lakeshore Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The lake keeps things cold. This is still cold.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Legs (Int/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Iceshard Ring
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Water beads and runs off, or doesn't.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Agi/Int)

quests.title: The Old Homestead
quests.description: Farmhand Joss remembers a stable, a farmhouse and a woman who made bread. He thinks it was south of the Brill road, near an overgrown paddock. He wants someone to walk the place and tell him whether it's still there.
quests.accept_text: Balnir, I think they called it. South of the east road. Look at the farmhouse for me and tell me what's left.
quests.turn_in_text: The stable's still standing? That's... something. Thank you. I'll remember it better now.

unique_item_defs.name: Saddle-Worn Treads
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Smells of hay and horse. The horses are gone.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Boots (Agi/Sta/AP)

unique_item_defs.name: Hay-Dusted Shoulderguards
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Worn by someone who still hoped.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Shoulders (Int/Hit/SP)

unique_item_defs.name: Worg-Scarred Sword
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A stableboy's, with a stableboy's patches.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Sta/Armor/Parry)

quests.title: Lost Cargo
quests.description: Trader Ilvessa's shipment never made it from the Undercity zeppelin to her stall. Scavengers picked it clean on the road, and she wants her crates back before the next shipment arrives and the scavengers get ideas.
quests.accept_text: Ragged scavengers along the Eastern road. They steal anything that glints. Six crates, please.
quests.turn_in_text: My goods! Mostly my goods. Take your cut, darling.

unique_item_defs.name: Cargo-Hauler's Belt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Whoever carried freight in this carried it well.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Belt (Str/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Cargo-Hauler's Girdle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Goblin work: sturdy, overpriced and slightly wrong.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Belt (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Landing-Dock Band
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Whoever carried freight in this carried it well.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Sta/Spi)

quests.title: Howls in the Vale
quests.description: Ranger Corvin Ashe walks the Vale's edge for the Deathguard, and the Bleak Worgs have been getting bolder. He needs the pack thinned before it learns to climb the road.
quests.accept_text: They hunt in the dusk. Eight should keep them wary. Aim for the grey ones, they lead.
quests.turn_in_text: That's quieter. Nobody ever thanks a ranger for what doesn't happen. I'm thanking you.

unique_item_defs.name: Hollow-Hunter's Helm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Somebody left it where the road bends. You can see why.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Helm (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Nightmare Bindings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Somebody left it where the road bends. You can see why.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Thorn-Torn Necklace
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Worn thin by thorn and branch.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/Sta)

quests.title: Crawling Things
quests.description: Nightcrawlers burrow in the Vale's loam and snap at anyone who walks overhead. Corvin has lost two boots to them and more dignity than he cares to admit.
quests.accept_text: Under the roots. You'll feel them before you see them. Seven, please, before they grow.
quests.turn_in_text: Good. A man can walk again. Take a piece of the kit.

unique_item_defs.name: Moth-Eaten Cape
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Worn thin by thorn and branch.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Cloak (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Gloamwood Vestments
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Somebody left it where the road bends. You can see why.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Chest (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Thorn-Torn Axe
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Worn thin by thorn and branch.
unique_item_defs.label: Axe (Str)

quests.title: The Needler
quests.description: A big old duskbat called Ressan the Needler nests above the Vale road. Needle-sharp teeth, a taste for ankles, and a flock that follows him. Corvin has had enough.
quests.accept_text: He's a brute, flies low, and screams. Clear his flock and then him. I'll watch from here, with my boots on.
quests.turn_in_text: He's down. I can hear myself think. Well done. Take your pick.

unique_item_defs.name: Dusk-Vale Treads
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The Vale never lets you wash it out.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Boots (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Moth-Eaten Veil
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The Vale never lets you wash it out.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Helm (Sta/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Dusk-Vale Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Smells of loam and wolf. Both are mostly gone.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Sta/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Gloamwood Chausses
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cut for someone who lived in the dark, and liked it.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Legs (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Reapers at the Door
quests.description: Watcher Pell has kept the Cold Hearth gate for a year and the reapers have never stopped coming. They come up out of the manor cellars with scythes and no manners.
quests.accept_text: Eight, and be careful with the scythes. They've been sharpened since before you died.
quests.turn_in_text: Eight. That's the first quiet watch in a month. Take something from the pile.

unique_item_defs.name: Manor-Reaper's Cuffs
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It was a servant's once. Someone rose from it in a hurry.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Bracers (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Manor-Reaper's Visor
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It was a servant's once. Someone rose from it in a hurry.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Helm (Str/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Ash-Hearth Knife
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The manor's chimney has been cold a long time. This remembers.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi/Sta)

quests.title: The Hall Fills Up
quests.description: The reapers aren't the only thing in the hall. Zombies and Rotting Dead pour out of the grounds as if the manor were calling them home.
quests.accept_text: Clear the gardens. Zombies and the rotted ones. The sooner they stop coming, the sooner I stop watching.
quests.turn_in_text: The gardens are empty. For now. Thank you. Your pick of the lot.

unique_item_defs.name: Draught-Chilled Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It was a servant's once. Someone rose from it in a hurry.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Bracers (Str/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Cold Hearth Bindings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Hung in the hall until the reapers rose.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Manor-Reaper's Saber
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It was a servant's once. Someone rose from it in a hurry.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Str/Agi)

quests.title: The Reaper-Lord
quests.description: Reaper-Lord Aldous is what the manor's dead report to: a tall, scythe-armed wreck who thinks the hall is still his. Pell would like him to be wrong.
quests.accept_text: Inside the hall, at the hearth. His reapers will guard him. Take them first, then Aldous.
quests.turn_in_text: The Lord of the Hall, in pieces. I'll have the hearth lit again. Take what you want.

unique_item_defs.name: Ash-Hearth Spaulders
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It was a servant's once. Someone rose from it in a hurry.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Shoulders (Str/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Mourning-Hall Wraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The manor's chimney has been cold a long time. This remembers.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Chimney-Black Glaive
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The manor's chimney has been cold a long time. This remembers.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Draught-Chilled Vest
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The manor's chimney has been cold a long time. This remembers.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Spi)

quests.title: Vile Fins on the Strand
quests.description: Fisher Quillon's nets are in tatters and his boat is gone. The Vile Fin murlocs on Whispering Shore took the boat and use the nets as hats. He wants them put in their place.
quests.accept_text: Along the strand to the north-west. The little ones. Eight, and bring back my dignity if you find it.
quests.turn_in_text: That'll teach them. Probably not, but it'll teach me something. Take a piece of what's left.

unique_item_defs.name: Brine-Stained Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Wet to the touch even when it is dry.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Legs (Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Shore-Reed Jerkin
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Wet to the touch even when it is dry.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Brine-Stained Flail
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Wind off the water gets in the seams.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Oracle's Pearls
quests.description: The oracles wear pearls to speak to the tide, and the tide has been speaking a great deal of nonsense lately. Quillon thinks taking the pearls might quiet it.
quests.accept_text: The Minor Oracles carry them. Five pearls, and if the tide screams, run.
quests.turn_in_text: Quiet at last. Even the gulls have stopped. Your pick, friend.

unique_item_defs.name: Salt-Crusted Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Dried by wind, never by sun.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Boots (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Brine-Stained Handguards
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Wet to the touch even when it is dry.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Gloves (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Kelp-Woven Walking Stick
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The Vile Fins left it on the strand. Maybe a sacrifice.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int/Spi)

quests.title: Old Gillrot
quests.description: Old Gillrot leads the Vile Fins, a withered oracle with a staff made from a drowned man's mast. He's the one who stole the boat. Quillon wants it back.
quests.accept_text: He sits on the biggest rock. His oracles heal him, so thin them first, then Gillrot.
